correctness.rationale: Orbit-barycenter triangulation is exact for actual geometric fixed subsets. All allowed orbits and all compatibility types are derived from Hamming inequalities. The four fixed blocks have simply connected Rips complexes (distance-two shortcut triangles and filled cube squares). Van Kampen and connected-link cones reduce π1 to a quotient of the four-rung square π1=Z. Coordinate deletion is a simplicial retraction to F4, and the independently checked 11 elementary collapses of F4 yield a circle, forcing the quotient to be exactly Z. No empirical extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: This yields an infinite-family exact fundamental-group invariant, a split simplicial retraction, and unexpected equality between the fixed locus of the diagonal involution and the whole Klein-four group. The stable surviving loop is invisible in the simply connected ambient scale-two Rips complex, motivating actual geometric fixed-space rather than character calculations. The claim has structural significance beyond a single finite census or parameter substitution.
